name: c-di-AMP riboswitch bound to cyclic di-AMP (2BA)
notes: c-di-AMP riboswitch (ydaO class) at 2.72 Å. 2BA is cyclic-di-AMP (MW ~658, 2 P atoms, residue 203). Both adenine bases stack on receptor; pyrophosphate contacts backbone. SO4 stripped; Mg retained. Second copy of 2BA (residue 204) excluded. Complement to 3IRW: tests same aptamer scoring terms with adenine vs guanine rings. Ref: Ren et al. 2015 Nature.
